responsibility: Declares the XML state-dump facility used to render an analyzer program_state as a structured diagnostic document. It defines the xml_state document builder class, its region-to-element mapping and inferred-type caches, and the helper APIs for creating XML elements from regions, binding clusters, concrete bindings, bit ranges, and svalues so program_state can expose a readable state-diagram view distinct from its ordinary textual dump.
same_name_distinction: Declares the interface and internal class layout for the ana-state-to-diagnostic-state facility, including xml_state methods, caches, and region-to-element mappings. In contrast, the same-stem .cc file supplies the actual XML-building logic, region/svalue serialization, and program_state dump_xml/make_xml definitions.
